verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM's built-in assistant Zia is documented as performing delegated tasks: creating modules, reports and workflows, and retrieving requested data. Zia agents also 'execute tasks on your behalf' and can be hired from an in-product Agent Store. The MCP server is an external-tool integration, not the built-in assistant, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how delegation works (scope, approvals, task review), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Zia can create modules, reports, and workflows in seconds, as well as retrieve any data you ask for
